const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Live visual controller record for the RoboCasa365 OvenBroilFish episode.
+
+This file uses only the RCB client observations (RGB, depth, calibration, and
+robot proprioception).  It does not reset the episode or access simulator state.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+CENTER = "robot0_agentview_center"
+HAND = "robot0_eye_in_hand"
+
+
+def world_point(cam_meta, depth_m, u, v):
+    """Back-project one depth pixel using the response's OpenGL camera pose."""
+    K = np.asarray(cam_meta["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
+    T = np.asarray(cam_meta["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)
+    z = float(depth_m)
+    p_cam = np.array([(u-K[0, 2])*z/K[0, 0],
+                      -(v-K[1, 2])*z/K[1, 1], -z, 1.0])
+    return (T @ p_cam)[:3]
+
+
+def find_red_target(rgb, depth, cam_meta):
+    """Estimate the visible fish center from its red pixels on the work surface."""
+    r, g, b = [rgb[..., i].astype(float) for i in range(3)]
+    h, w = depth.shape
+    yy, xx = np.mgrid[:h, :w]
+    mask = ((r > 60) & (r > 1.25*g) & (r > 1.15*b) &
+            (depth > 0) & (depth < 2.0) &
+            (xx > 220) & (xx < 300) & (yy > 135) & (yy < 215))
+    ys, xs = np.where(mask)
+    if len(xs) < 8:
+        return None
+    pts = [world_point(cam_meta, depth[v, u], u, v)
+           for u, v in zip(xs, ys)]
+    return np.median(np.asarray(pts), axis=0)
+
+
+def action_row(q, grip=-1.0, base=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), torso=0.0, mode=-1.0):
+    row = np.zeros(13, dtype=np.float64)
+    row[:7] = np.asarray(q, dtype=float)
+    row[7] = grip
+    row[8:11] = base
+    row[11] = torso
+    row[12] = mode
+    return row
+
+
+def move_joints(robot, q_target, steps=20, grip=-1.0):
+    """Smoothly move from measured joints to an absolute joint target."""
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=[CENTER, HAND], video="none")
+    q0 = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][4:11], dtype=float)
+    q1 = np.asarray(q_target, dtype=float)
+    actions = np.zeros((steps, 13), dtype=np.float64)
+    actions[:, :7] = np.linspace(q0, q1, steps)
+    actions[:, 7] = grip
+    actions[:, 12] = -1.0
+    return robot.submit("joint_position", actions, interpolate="hold",
+                        cameras=[CENTER, HAND], video="none")
+
+
+def inspect(robot):
+    """Read current sensors and return the visible fish and hand positions."""
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=[CENTER, HAND], include_depth=True, video="none")
+    fish = find_red_target(obs.last[CENTER], obs.depth[CENTER][0],
+                           obs.meta["cameras"][CENTER])
+    proprio = obs.meta["proprio"]["now"]
+    return obs, fish, np.asarray(proprio[26:29], dtype=float)
+
+
+def main():
+    robot = Robot()
+    obs, fish_xyz, ee_xyz = inspect(robot)
+    print({"status": robot.status(), "fish_xyz_from_rgbd": fish_xyz,
+           "ee_xyz": ee_xyz, "time_left_s": obs.meta.get("time_left_s")})
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
